text: The security_reporter is woken by the analysis_correct outcome label or a downstream trigger — when no open PR/issue exists to label, the reporter will not fire automatically after the reviewer approves; a tracking issue must be created first.

When a security reviewer returns [PASS] on rerun because verdict.json already holds 'approve', no further action is needed — the batch is complete and the reviewer should not re-review or re-register artifacts.
